snippet.title: Nimbit Frontier - Official Early Access Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Nimbit Frontier will come to early access on 17 August 2026.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477710/Nimbit_Frontier/

Nimbit Frontier is a cozy creature-collecting life sim with deep creature care, roguelite action, and a focus on nurturing, discovery, and atmosphere. Raise adorable Nimbits, build cozy custom habitats, and explore the shifting Underwild to uncover rare species and support their conservation. 

Developer: Megasploot
